announcements.headline: Total number of shares and voting rights at October 31, 2026
announcements.insight: This is a standard monthly regulatory filing required by the Paris BSE for all listed companies, detailing share count and voting rights without conveying new material information or strategic shifts.

announcements.headline: Orange: Orange announces that it has purchased treasury shares within the framework of its share buyback program.
announcements.insight: Routine treasury share acquisition under an existing buyback program signals capital return discipline rather than strategic transformation; typical for mature telecom operators like Orange managing free cash flow in a saturated European market.
